subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Anglo-American Model
description: A 60-second lesson on The Anglo-American Model.

hook.text: In the US and UK, thousands of shareholders own each company. No single owner calls the shots.

buildup.text: The Anglo-American model features dispersed ownership, active stock markets, and strong shareholder rights.

discovery.text: A single board of directors oversees management. External market pressure disciplines underperformers.

twist.text: Dispersed ownership means no single shareholder can hold management truly accountable.

climax.text: The Anglo-American model relies on markets, not owners, to discipline companies. It works until it doesn't.

punchline.text: Many owners. No single boss. The market decides.

quiz.question: What characterizes the Anglo-American governance model?
options: Dispersed ownership and strong stock market influence
Single family ownership of all companies
